newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fixes at highest since 1980.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fixes at highest since 1980.

text.p: Palladium fixed at $245.50 per ounce on Tuesday, its highest level since 1980.
It had fixed at $239.00 on Monday afternoon, just a dollar below the previous 17-year high set on June 6.
Prices have been rising all year for palladium and its sister metal platinum due to leading exporter Russia failing to start its 1997 export campaign until last month.
Administrative problems and personnel changes were blamed for the delay which has caused consumers to use up their inventories and send dealers scrambling for material.
The latest price surge began when investors in Tokyo who had betted that palladium prices would fall after Russia began to deliver, found prices rising instead and they had to cover their positions.
"They were caught out by the dollar forcing prices in yen up and there are not too many people willing to sell," a dealer said.
